title: I Can't Believe I Slept With You!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Twenty-four-year-old Chiyo Koduka has quit her job and fallen three months behind on rent. Her landlady offers to settle the debt in exchange for favors, beginning with sleeping together, and the two women keep up the arrangement as it slowly becomes a real relationship.
life_message: It holds up honest connection and getting one's life together as able to grow even from an unlikely beginning.

content.note: Loneliness and money worries; comedic tone (Wikipedia, ANN review summary).
Premise is a sex-for-rent arrangement and a one-night stand (Wikipedia, Seven Seas blurb); MU lists Dubious Consent, Partial Nudity, Prostitution; MangaDex suggestive.
Chiyo drinks beer as escapism (Seven Seas blurb); MU Alcohol, Drunken Intercourse.
Self-pity, unemployment and loneliness; AniList Hikikomori tag (to verify).
Sex offered as payment for debt treated as a comic premise (Wikipedia; MU Dubious Consent, Prostitution).

folkways.japan: The landlord-tenant relationship and quiet social pressure around non-heteronormative identity reflect Japanese norms, which ANN's review says the series raises realistically.
